text: 出门前，刺猬在半壳口试了一下高度。新做的帽子先碰到叶檐，差点连自己的脑袋一起卡住。你想看它戴一顶出门用的小帽子，它挑了浅黄的落叶，折成圆圆的低帽顶，留下窄帽檐，草纤维绕成一圈固定。它把帽顶压低一些，让两只圆耳从帽子两侧露出来，再走过一回：这下连软刺也没蹭到雨檐。半壳侧边的空蝉蜕安稳抱着短枝，它绕开收藏区，戴好这顶小圆叶帽往草坡走。帽檐上落了一滴水；它低头一甩，水滚下去，帽子还在。

Preserve the entire body artwork beneath the added hat.

The hat sits between the two ears and BOTH ears remain fully visible outside the sides, as in the reference. Hat is small and low, not tall, not broad brimmed. It must not cover the face, eyes, cream short snout, ears, or the mature brown quill clusters behind the head. Tiny leaf folds can read as two or three broad pixel patches; no detailed woven texture.
Style: retain reference's charming cartoon pixel sprite, blocky stepped outline and a few clear color blocks. Every edge and detail follows the existing visible pixel scale. Do not redraw anatomy, soften pixels, add realistic textures or change body color.
Composition: keep one full-body hedgehog centered, comfortable transparent margins; no objects, landscape or floor, no shadow blob, no other clothing, hands-held items or text. Genuine transparent PNG with intact alpha. A single base Avatar, not an animation atlas.
